Splits the text into Objectives and Key Results and guesses each KR's kind, target, unit
and due date. Nothing is stored; the client adds the result to its draft.

502.description: The AI provider failed or returned unusable output

delete.description:
Deletes the quarter's data: OKRs, tasks, pins, plan and schedule runs, calendar override.

Global data (leave days, holidays, settings) is kept. 409 while a plan is running.

put.description:
Sets the first day tasks may be scheduled (e.g. Q4 but start on 10 Oct). Existing
schedules are not recomputed; they show as stale until the next plan or reschedule.

get.description: The closest earlier quarter that exists; 404 ``no_previous_quarter`` when there is none.

schema.title: Response List Quarter Tasks Quarters  Quarter Id  Tasks Get

get.description:
Latest schedule of the quarter; 404 ``schedule_not_found`` until a plan succeeded
or the quarter was rescheduled.

patch.description: A pinned task whose estimate changes is re-pinned from its first pinned day.

delete.description: Dependents lose the link by default; ``with_dependents`` deletes them too (transitively).

put.description: Moves the task and pins it; a pin may overfill a day, which reschedule reports.

post.description:
Recomputes the whole quarter from today with the deterministic scheduler.

Pinned tasks keep their days. Every pin conflict (overfull day, day off, past day,
unfinished dependency) is listed; the schedule is stored only when each conflicting task has
a resolution in the request. Finished tasks keep their history.

get.description:
Weekly and monthly expected values of each active KR of an active objective.

``expected_value`` is null for KRs without a numeric baseline and target. Without a stored
schedule only finished tasks count.

schema.title: Response Get Kr Milestones Quarters  Quarter Id  Kr Milestones Get

get.description:
Each option on its own (more hours on weekdays, Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, drop the
lowest-priority late KR or objective, defer each late KR to the next quarter).

``weekday_hint`` gives the smallest extra minutes per weekday that clears the red warnings
and that turns the plan green. Nothing is stored; no option is selected by default.

post.description:
Before/after of a combination of options, from one scheduler run; nothing is stored.

422 ``options_conflict`` when two options exclude each other (e.g. dropping and deferring
the same KR), ``unknown_option`` or ``option_not_applicable`` for invalid ids.

Applies the options and stores a new schedule in one transaction.

Calendar options change this quarter's own settings, never the global ones. Deferring a KR
moves it with its tasks to the next quarter (created when missing). The same
``Idempotency-Key`` with the same body returns the first result; with another body it is
409 ``idempotency_key_reused``. 409 ``plan_in_progress`` while a plan is running.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Repeating a request with the same key returns the first result

post.description:
Restores the settings, KRs and objectives changed by the application and reschedules.

Undoing twice returns the same result. 409 ``undo_not_latest`` when a later application of
the quarter is still in place, ``undo_conflict`` when a moved KR has nowhere to go back to.

get.description:
XLSX has three sheets: tasks, daily schedule and weekly workload. Hours come from the
latest stored schedule; dates are ISO. Never contains passwords or API keys.

Continue a run that failed at ``decompose`` or ``dedup``; starts a new run (new
``job_id``, ``parent_id`` = the failed run) that only asks the model for the key results
not yet decomposed. 409 ``okr_changed`` when the OKR was edited since: generate anew.
